full_judgment: 18. Sub-section (1) of" section 40C of the Insurance Act 1938 further deals with the limitation of expenses of management in general insurance business, wherein the procedure for condo- nation of any excess expenditure has also been incorporated along with the further item of management expenses. The aforesaid provision for condonation of violation appears to be made the provision for management expenses a directory one allowing a discretion to the controller of Insurance to consider reasonability of the violation, but the learned Deputy Attorney-General Mr Abu Amzad erroneously attempted to impress this court that the violation of the limit of management expenses shall take away the insurance company out of the ambit of section 40C of the Insurance Act 1938. The learned Deputy Attorney-General Mr Abu Amzad failed to notice that even the violation of the provision of section 40C of the Insurance Act 1938 and to obtain the condonation of such violation from the Controller of Insurance is also a compliance of the Insurance Act 1938 and therefore the finding of the DCT concern that the Assessee-applicant insurance companies have failed to comply the provision of Insurance Act 1938 is nothing but misconceived interpretation of law.
